    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    A bishop: moves any number of squares diagonally.
    Board
    The 8 x 8 grid of squares and the record of captured pieces.
    ChessApp
    Entry point for the interactive console chess application.
    Command
    A single parsed line of user input, produced by InputParser.
    Command.Type
    The kinds of command the console understands.
    ConsoleUI
    Text interface for the game: prints the board, reads commands, and forwards moves to Game.
    DemoDriver
    Non-interactive demonstration driver that runs labeled test scenarios against Game and InputParser, printing the input, the expected result, the observed result, and PASS/FAIL for each check.
    Game
    Coordinates a two-player game: owns the board, the players, and the turn, and decides whether a requested move is allowed.
    InputParser
    Converts raw text typed by the user into a Command.
    King
    A king: moves exactly one square in any direction.
    Knight
    A knight: moves in an "L" (two squares on one axis, one on the other) and may jump over any intervening pieces.
    MoveResult
    The outcome of an attempted move, returned by Game.tryMove(Position, Position).
    Pawn
    A pawn: moves forward one square into an empty square, or two squares from its starting rank if both squares are empty, and captures one square diagonally forward.
    Piece
    Abstract base class for all six chess piece types.
    PieceColor
    The two sides in a chess game.
    Player
    One of the two people playing the game.
    Position
    An immutable square on the 8 x 8 board.
    Queen
    A queen: combines rook and bishop movement.
    Rook
    A rook: moves any number of squares along a rank or file.
